name: Ichimatsu
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c53075]Izui's[/url] older brother who came back from studying in America. He's a bioengineer.
He looks almost identical to Izui, but personality-wise, they are total opposites. They don't get along too well. Unlike Izui, he's warm, friendly and easy-going, though his mannerisms seem fake. He constantly peppers his speech with Engrish and insists that people call him Jackie. Even though he's the older brother, he's a bit shorter than Izui. He gives supplementary English lessons at Togai Private High School. [spoiler]He's dating [url=https://vndb.org/c52971]Hanako[/url].[spoiler]
